title: 第8章 签到地刷新，第十序列，君仗剑出关！
content_zh:
之后，君逍遥便带着君玲珑，和君战天一起，回到了天帝宫。
至于斗武场的其他君家子弟，则是一脸艳羡和敬畏的注视其离去。
若君逍遥表现不佳，众人心里自然会有微辞。
不过现在，君逍遥的表现，已经完全征服了众人。
没看到连君玲珑都心甘情愿当君逍遥的侍女吗？
“你们说，君仗剑会不会找回场子？”一位君家年轻人饶有兴趣问道。
“不会吧，只要君仗剑不傻，应该不会去招惹神子。”其余人摇头道。
谁都知道，君逍遥颇受十八祖重视，前途无量，日后注定是君家的顶梁柱。
君仗剑若因为一个兰清雅，就去得罪君逍遥，那绝对是脑子抽抽了。
至于君逍遥本人，则根本没有把君仗剑的事放在心上。
他若前来替兰清雅找场子，君逍遥还很乐意与其交手。
“这就是天帝宫吗？”
君玲珑看着面前恢弘大气的宫殿，神情也是有着一缕激动。
她的身份地位虽高，却也没有资格进入天帝宫。
“随意一点，不用拘谨。”君逍遥摆摆手。
“多谢神子大人。”君玲珑对着君逍遥一拜，甜甜一笑。
“换做其他人，想让君玲珑多看一眼都难，我却可以随手将其收为侍女，这就是权势与地位吗？”君逍遥暗暗咋舌。
投胎果然是门技术活。
“对了，爷爷，以后有玲珑照顾孙儿起居，您就不用天天来了。”君逍遥转头道。
“嘿，你这孙子……”君战天吹胡子瞪眼。

有了漂亮侍女，转身就把爷爷抛了是不是？
不过拗不过君逍遥，君战天还是妥协了，但有时需要讲道的话，他还是会前来。
接下来数日，君逍遥都在参悟神象镇狱劲这门炼体功法。
神象镇狱劲，可不单单只是修炼出巨力，其中更是有着种种武学法门的演化。
比如可以演化出至强攻击法门，冥神之矛。
因为太古神象，可以镇压无边地狱，汲取地狱灵气，化为穿破一切之矛。
还可演化最强防御法门，冥神守护，不破不灭。
甚至还可以凝聚出恶魔之翼，双翅一震，虚空极速。
随着君逍遥参悟深入，之后解锁的能力，会越来越多。
到最后，甚至可以演化出真正的太古神象，召唤地狱之门，无尽群魔都为君逍遥而战！
“这神象镇狱劲，实在是太实用了。”君逍遥赞叹不已。
君家虽然也有许多至高炼体法门，但在功能性方面，却没有神象镇狱劲这么齐全。
“真希望还有签到的机会。”君逍遥都有些迫不及待想要再次签到。
就在这时，君逍遥脑海内，再度有系统的声音传来。
“恭喜宿主，新的签到地点已刷新！”
“请在十岁宴上签到！”
君逍遥听到这声音，微微一愣：“十岁宴，是我的十岁宴吗？”
他倒是听君战天说了，等他十岁时，君家将会为他举办一次盛大的十岁宴。
到时候，将广邀荒天仙域诸多势力，荒古世家，无上大族等等，前来赴宴。
甚至于君逍遥零号序列的身份，也将在十岁宴上公布。

这场宴会，就是君逍遥入世的第一次登场。
“看来签到的地点和时间是随机的，并没有规律。”君逍遥思索道。
不过这也没什么，神象镇狱劲和混沌神魔观想法，已经足够君逍遥现在修炼了。
“倒是有点期待十岁宴了……”君逍遥嘴角勾起淡笑。
“对了，君仗剑那边怎么还没有动静，难道真的怂了？”
君逍遥暗暗嘀咕着，还稍稍有些失望。
同一时间。
君家内，一处悬浮于虚空的灵岛之上。
君家十大序列，待遇同寻常天骄不同，各自拥有一座独立的宅邸。
或是天宫，或是神岛，或是洞天福地。
这座灵岛，则是君家第十序列，君仗剑的宅邸。
灵岛之上，有一座山峰，宛如一柄长剑，插入天际，散发着惶惶然如天威般的剑气！
在山峰脚下，一袭蓝裙的兰清雅，已经在此等待了数日。
“仗剑公子还未出关吗？”兰清雅神情透露着焦急，委屈，不甘。
越是想起斗武场上发生的事情，兰清雅越是感觉憋屈愤怒。
但她又不敢找君逍遥和君玲珑的麻烦，只能依靠君仗剑。
以往每次，有人得罪了兰清雅，只要找君仗剑，最后一定是别人赔礼道歉。
正是因此，才养成了兰清雅这样骄矜的性格。
就在这时，山峰之顶，猛然传来了一股巨大波动。
恐怖的法力风暴，横贯天地之间，如同形成了龙卷风。

“是仗剑公子，他又突破了！”
灵岛之上，一些君仗剑的追随者被惊动，目光皆是眺望那山峰之上。
兰清雅脸上一扫委屈之色，显得非常振奋。
君仗剑突破了，实力再度加强，想必可以帮她出气。
不说教训君逍遥，至少也要教训一下君玲珑。
山峰之上，一位背剑的黑袍少年，步踏虚空而下。
一般而言，在灵海境后，到达神宫境，便可踏空而行。
很显然，这位黑袍少年，已经是神宫境高手。
他年纪约莫十三四岁，墨发飘扬，黑瞳深邃，整个人的气质，宛如一柄斩破苍天的神剑，令人望而生畏。
这黑袍少年，正是君家第十序列，君仗剑！
传闻他降生之日，君家所有佩剑之人，长剑皆是自主出鞘，指向君仗剑的出生地。
他天生剑心通明，更身怀不灭剑体，可容纳无尽剑气于体内，对于剑道功法武学，更是有着妖孽的天赋。
正是因为这种种天赋，才让君仗剑强势崛起，成为了十大序列之一。
虽然只是排名最末尾的第十序列，但依然不可小觑。
要知道，整个君家，年轻天骄千千万，想要得到一个序列身份何其艰难。
不是谁都像君逍遥那样，生来高高在上，地位非凡。
“清雅，你一直在等我吗？”
君仗剑落地，周围一群追随者都是躬身拱手，君仗剑却是直接忽视，看向兰清雅。
“仗剑公子！”
兰清雅挤出几滴眼泪，一脸委屈之色，扑到了君仗剑怀中。

“这婊子……”其他追随者，心里暗骂，眼中露出鄙夷之色。
同为君仗剑的追随者，他们也看不惯兰清雅的做派。
还说别人君玲珑是绿茶婊，自己才是真正的绿茶婊吧。
“怎么了，又是谁惹你不开心了？”君仗剑淡淡一笑。
他的确颇为宠幸兰清雅，对她的态度和其余追随者不同。
“事情是这样的……”兰清雅将事情全数讲出。
然后她自顾自的委屈垂泪道：“仗剑公子，清雅都是为了您的面子着想，谁曾想，那君逍遥和君玲珑……”
“你说……你得罪了君逍遥？”
黑发遮掩了君仗剑的眸子，让人看不清他的表情。
“是啊，仗剑公子，您可一定要为清雅讨回一个公道……”兰清雅委屈巴巴道。
然而迎接她的，却是一个响亮的巴掌！
“你这是想害死我吗！？”
content_en:
After that, Jun Xiaoyao took Jun Linglong and Jun Zhantian back to the Emperor's Palace.
As for the other Jun family disciples in the fighting arena, they watched him leave with envy and awe.
If Jun Xiaoyao does not perform well, everyone will naturally feel resentful.
But now, Jun Xiaoyao's performance has completely conquered everyone.
Haven't you seen that even Jun Linglong is willing to be Jun Xiaoyao's maid?
"Do you think Jun Zhanjian will regain his reputation?" A young man from the Jun family asked with interest.
"No, as long as you are not stupid with your sword, you probably won't provoke the Son of God." The others shook their heads.
Everyone knows that Jun Xiaoyao is highly valued by the Eighteenth Ancestor and has a bright future. He is destined to be the pillar of the Jun family in the future.
If Jun Zhanjian offended Jun Xiaoyao because of Lan Qingya, he would definitely be out of his mind.
As for Jun Xiaoyao himself, he didn't take Jun Zhanjian's matter to heart at all.
If he comes to find a place for Lan Qingya, Jun Xiaoyao will be happy to fight with him.
"Is this the Heavenly Emperor's Palace?"
Jun Linglong looked at the magnificent palace in front of her with a hint of excitement in her expression.
Although her status is high, she is not qualified to enter the Emperor's Palace.
"Be casual, don't be formal." Jun Xiaoyao waved his hand.
"Thank you, Lord Son of God." Jun Linglong bowed to Jun Xiaoyao and smiled sweetly.
"If it were anyone else, it would be difficult for Jun Linglong to take another look at her, but I can easily accept her as a maid. Is this power and status?" Jun Xiaoyao secretly exclaimed.
Reincarnation is indeed a technical job.
"By the way, Grandpa, from now on Linglong will take care of your grandson's daily life, so you won't have to come every day." Jun Xiaoyao turned around and said.
"Hey, your grandson..." Jun Zhantian puffed his beard and glared.
When you have a beautiful maid, you turn around and abandon your grandfather, right?
But he couldn't resist Jun Xiaoyao, so Jun Zhantian still compromised, but sometimes he would still come if he needed to preach.
In the next few days, Jun Xiaoyao studied the body-training technique called Divine Elephant Prison Suppressing Strength.
The divine elephant's prison-suppressing power is not only about cultivating great strength, but also includes the evolution of various martial arts techniques.
For example, it can evolve into the most powerful attack method, the Spear of Hades.
Because the ancient idol can suppress the boundless hell, absorb the aura of hell, and turn it into a spear that can penetrate everything.
It can also evolve the strongest defensive method, which is protected by the god of Hades and is indestructible.
It can even condense the devil's wings, and when its wings vibrate, it can reach extreme speeds in the void.
As Jun Xiaoyao deepens his understanding, more and more abilities will be unlocked in the future.
In the end, you can even evolve into a real ancient god, summon the gate of hell, and countless demons will fight for you!
"This divine elephant's prison-suppressing power is really practical." Jun Xiaoyao was full of praise.
Although the Jun family also has many supreme body-refining methods, in terms of functionality, they are not as complete as the divine elephant's prison-suppressing power.
"I really hope there is still a chance to sign in." Jun Xiaoyao couldn't wait to sign in again.
At this moment, a systematic voice came from Jun Xiaoyao's mind again.
"Congratulations to the host, the new check-in location has been refreshed!"
"Please sign in at the tenth birthday party!"
When Jun Xiaoyao heard this voice, he was slightly startled: "The ten-year-old banquet, is it my ten-year-old banquet?"
He actually heard from Jun Zhantian that when he turns ten, the Jun family will hold a grand tenth-year-old banquet for him.
At that time, many forces in the Desolate Heaven Immortal Domain, including the Desolate Ancient Family, the Supreme Clan, etc. will be invited to come to the banquet.
Even the identity of Jun Xiaoyao's serial number 0 will be announced at the tenth-year-old banquet.
This banquet was Jun Xiaoyao's first appearance in the world.
"It seems that the location and time of the check-in are random and there is no pattern." Jun Xiaoyao thought.
But it doesn't matter. The divine elephant's prison-suppressing power and the concept of chaos gods and demons are enough for Jun Xiaoyao to practice now.
"I'm kind of looking forward to the ten-year-old banquet..." Jun Xiaoyao curled up into a smile.
"By the way, Jun Zhanjian is over thereWhy is there no movement yet? Are you really scared? "
Jun Xiaoyao muttered secretly, still slightly disappointed.
at the same time.
In Jun's house, there is a spiritual island suspended in the void.
The top ten members of the Jun family are treated differently from ordinary geniuses, and each has an independent mansion.
Either a heavenly palace, a divine island, or a paradise in the cave.
This spiritual island is the tenth rank of the Jun family and the residence of Jun Zhanjian.
On the spiritual island, there is a mountain peak, like a long sword, thrust into the sky, exuding a frightening sword energy like the power of heaven!
At the foot of the mountain, Lan Qingya, dressed in a blue dress, has been waiting here for several days.
"Is Master Zhanjian still out of seclusion? "Lan Qingya's expression showed anxiety, grievance, and unwillingness.
The more she thought about what happened in the fighting arena, the more aggrieved and angry Lan Qingya felt.
But she didn't dare to cause trouble with Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Linglong, so she could only rely on Jun Zhanjian.
In the past, every time someone offended Lan Qingya, as long as they approached Jun Zhanjian, someone else would end up apologizing.
It is precisely because of this that Lan Qingya developed such a proud character.
At this moment, a huge wave suddenly came from the top of the mountain.
The terrifying mana storm spread across the sky and earth, like a tornado.
"It's Young Master Zhanjian, he's broken through again! "
On the Spirit Island, some of Jun Zhanjian's followers were alarmed, and their eyes were all looking at the mountain peak.
A look of grievance swept across Lan Qingya's face, and she looked very excited.
Jun Zhanjian broke through and strengthened again. He must be able to help her vent her anger.
Not only teach Jun Xiaoyao a lesson, but at least teach Jun Linglong a lesson.
On the top of the mountain, a young man in black robe with a sword on his back walked down through the void.
Generally speaking, after reaching the spiritual sea realm and reaching the divine palace realm, you can walk on the air.
It was obvious that this young man in black robe was already a master in the divine palace realm.
He was about thirteen or fourteen years old, with flowing black hair and deep black eyes. His whole aura was like a divine sword that cut through the sky, which was intimidating.
This young man in black robe is the tenth rank of the Jun family, Jun wields a sword!
Rumor has it that on the day he was born, all the people in the Jun family who wore swords unsheathed their swords on their own initiative, pointing towards Jun Zhanjian's birthplace.
He was born with a clear sword heart, and possessed an immortal sword body that could contain endless sword energy in his body. He also had a demonic talent for swordsmanship and martial arts.
It is precisely because of these talents that Jun Zhanjian rose to power and became one of the top ten sequences.
Although it is only the tenth sequence at the bottom, it is still not to be underestimated.
You know, there are thousands of young talents in the entire Jun family, and it is very difficult to obtain a serial identity.
Not everyone is like Jun Xiaoyao, who is born high and has an extraordinary status.
"Qingya, have you been waiting for me? "
Jun Zhanjian landed on the ground, and a group of followers around him bowed and raised their hands, but Jun Zhanjian ignored it and looked at Lan Qingya.
"Master Zhanjian! "
Lan Qingya squeezed out a few tears and threw herself into Jun Zhanjian's arms with a look of grievance on her face.
"This bitch..." The other followers cursed inwardly, with disdain in their eyes.
As followers of Jun Zhanjian, they also couldn't stand Lan Qingya's behavior.
She also said that Jun Linglong is a green tea bitch, but she is the real green tea bitch.
"What's wrong, who made you unhappy? "Jun Zhanjian smiled faintly.
He indeed favors Lan Qingya, and his attitude towards her is different from that of other followers.
"The thing is like this..." Lan Qingya told the whole story.
Then she said with tears in her eyes because of her own grievance: "Master Zhanjian, Qingya is all thinking about your face. Who would have thought that Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Linglong..."
"You said...you have offended Jun Xiaoyao? "
The black hair covered Jun Zhanjian's eyes, making his expression unclear.
"Yes, Master Zhanjian, you must seek justice for Qingya..." Lan Qingya said aggrievedly.
However, what greeted her was a loud slap!
"YouAre you trying to kill me? ? "
